description: `!{}`-guarded calls inside ARROW-valued handlers (RT). #expr: `(e) => risky() !{…}` — the .Empty arm sets @r = 1. #block: a block-bodied arrow whose guard adds 10 and whose second statement reads the arrow's parameter (the event): @kind = e.type = "click". Before S440 the arrow was emitted as-is from its expression view and the guard was dropped (`(e) => _scrml_risky()`, r stayed 0); the block form failed codegen (E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC).
rationale: §19.4.3 (S440 ruling) — an arrow body runs on the event exactly like `{ risky() }`, so it is checked the same way and its guard is emitted. §5.2.3 — no statement of a handler SHALL be dropped.
